How the Daily Check-in works — and its limits
Short, honest, and in plain language.

A 30-second face scan estimates heart rate and breathing rate from tiny colour changes in your skin (VitalLens API). Heart rate variability appears only when the service provides it. Every number comes with a confidence value; if confidence is low we ask you to retry and save nothing.
MediaPipe Pose runs inside your browser to notice slouching or a forward head, remind you to move after sitting, and count two gentle moves — chair sit-to-stand and shoulder rolls — with form tips.
Shifa' compares today's numbers with YOUR OWN usual baseline (not an average person), explains them in Arabic or English, and suggests one small habit for the week.
Your Primary Carer and doctor can see the trend. If a reading drifts from your baseline they get a gentle alert — at most once a day.
Posture and movement video is processed on this device only. It is never uploaded and never stored.

For camera vitals, short bursts of small face frames are sent securely to the VitalLens service to compute the estimate. Shifa' does not store video or images — only the resulting numbers and a timestamp.
If VitalLens is unavailable, an open-source method runs on your device instead (heart rate only).
The camera is only on while a scan or check is running, and you can stop at any time.
These are wellness estimates, not a medical diagnosis, and Shifa' is not a medical device.
We do not measure blood pressure, blood oxygen or blood sugar.
Lighting, movement, make-up, skin tone and camera quality all affect accuracy.
Posture checks use a single front camera, so they are approximate.
A change from your baseline is a prompt to pay attention — not a conclusion. Never change medication because of a check-in.
If you feel chest pain, severe breathlessness, fainting or sudden weakness, call 999 immediately.

How Shifa' protects your health data — in plain language.

and only starts after you explicitly turn it on. The camera is never activated secretly, continuous video is never stored, frames are analyzed on your own device, and only emergency events are saved — with your permission. You control who receives alerts, and you can stop monitoring at any time.
Medical data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
UAE PASS + email with a verification step (demo).
Vision monitoring runs on-device; frames are never uploaded.
Patients, Primary Carers, and doctors each see only what they should.
Monitoring and data sharing are opt-in, always reversible.
Labs, notes, and assessments are protected at the record level.
Hosted with encrypted storage and access controls.
Sensitive actions are traceable for accountability.
Who can see what — Role-Based Access Control
Everything about themselves — full history, assessments, AI conversations, monitoring.
Only the scopes the patient granted (medications, appointments, symptoms, safety alerts). Never private AI chats or hidden records.
Clinical history: surgeries, pain history, body assessments, labs, clinical notes, AI summaries, treatment plans, emergency events.
🔕 Monitoring is disabled until you enable it — no exceptions.
📵 Video is analyzed live on your device and is never uploaded or continuously recorded.
💾 Only emergency events (a fall, sustained inactivity) are saved — not footage.
🛑 You can stop monitoring instantly, and revoke camera permission in your browser at any time.
👥 You choose who gets alerted (your Primary Carer, and optionally your doctor).

Note: this is a hackathon prototype. Several protections above (2FA, audit logs, full encryption-at-rest) are represented at the product/UX level to show the intended production posture — see the README for exactly what is implemented versus planned.
